assessments.reasoning: The author’s commit-pinned root LICENSE names Marcin Krzyżanowski and lists four restrictions, ending with the acknowledgement retention requirement. The verified full-source SHA-256 is e4ea9188602dd4217309aec044481b0a7d2f9d539b1d1673b9a1809709c804e0. [Publisher source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krzyzanowskim/CryptoSwift/920e641bb563131f2ec6b5a8daa9040e5a0fe003/LICENSE)

The committed row links the same root file and matches its recomputed digest and the subject key. It records CryptoSwift License, kind license, edition cryptoswift-captured-reference, and lifecycle active for the complete notice. [Committed Index decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/software-commons/license-index/cffd21c29084a60c2fb00a9ee0d2c52780246c02/docs/decisions/three-project-notices-lifecycle-2026-11-28.md)

challenge.method: Recomputed SHA-256 over the full UTF-8 LICENSE, counted the individually listed restrictions, checked both forms of the author’s name, and compared the publisher URL, entity key, digest, edition, title, kind, and lifecycle against the committed row.
challenge.results: The copyright through the final acknowledgement occupies the entire capture, bytes [0,1045). Its digest matched the claim and row. The copyright uses Krzyżanowski, the final acknowledgement uses Krzyzanowski, and four separately listed restrictions appear. The supplemental v3.29.0 SPDX text preserves the four restrictions and omits the copyright-line email address. [SPDX text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/v3.29.0/text/CryptoSwift.txt)

limitations: The finding covers the exact root LICENSE capture and its Index lookup classification. Applicability to other works, legal equivalence, reuse, and installation require separate evidence.

Exact SPDX correspondence remains unverified. The supplied bindings identify neither the intended fixed SPDX representations nor an intended tag. I selected v3.29.0 for a supplemental comparison, verified the [release tag](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/releases/tag/v3.29.0), and obtained its text. The tagged XML request returned a cache miss.
reasoning: The fresh publisher capture supports the named author and count of conditions. The committed Index decision assigns the stated lifecycle to the same verified notice. The observed SPDX contact-line variant does not change either assertion under SCES-1.0 and the Codex Research Protocol.
